explication: This repository is a work-in-progress decompilation of The Wind Waker’s GameCube runtime, not a standalone game-asset package. The graph highlights input, process and event management, representative actor behavior, message presentation, audio, particles, and rendering/platform foundations. Relationships are limited to calls or references visible in the supplied excerpts, SOURCE INDEX, or README; unsampled systems and their wiring are not inferred.
